launch_plan.shared_design: One large focal point, scale or consequence visible at 168×94. House heavy sans, one yellow hook word, other words white, outline, clear top or edge band, no Orbit, no small text. Grade and phone-preview gates apply; C tests a bright high-contrast background.

concepts.picture: A huge brass compass dominates the lower two-thirds, its needle pointing down towards south. A smaller graded Earth limb and green aurora behind it give planetary scale. This illustrates a reversal, not a claim that the present drift has already reversed the field.
concepts.source_image: Original compass artwork to be built separately; NASA Apollo 17 Blue Marble Earth plate plus NASA ISS aurora imagery as reference. Verify exact assets and credits before building.

concepts.picture: One large Hubble telescope above the curved South Atlantic, its aperture turned away from a small bright radiation glow below. The telescope is the focal point; Earth is the scale reference. Depict an observing pause, with no broken spacecraft or explosion.
concepts.source_image: NASA/ESA Hubble servicing imagery as telescope reference; NASA Blue Marble Earth plate. Use the script's South Atlantic Anomaly passage as the scenario; exact source assets need verification.

concepts.picture: A single enormous green-and-crimson aurora curtain over a recognisable London skyline, with a tiny human silhouette for scale. Use a bright cyan twilight background with high contrast against the saturated curtain: a possible reversal-era sky, not a photograph of an observed event.
concepts.source_image: Original illustrative composite to be built separately; NASA ISS aurora imagery for curtain reference and a commercially usable London skyline photograph to be sourced and credited.
